WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS average_of_average_unit_prices,
  AVG(m.bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  AVG(m.bytes_per_millisecond - a.rate) AS average_rate_above_cross_media_average
FROM media_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE m.bytes_per_millisecond > a.rate;
